# Clipcam

> Privacy-first clips camera for the web. Hold to record, trim on a filmstrip, export one video — all on your device.

Clipcam is a free and open source progressive web app by Sohail Khan (https://me.jscrate.dev). Every feature is free — no subscription, no watermark. Projects stay private on the device until you share.

## Site

- [Home](/): Record and assemble clips in the browser
- [About](/about): Product overview and credits
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of use
- [Receive](/receive): Accept a project sent from another device

## For agents

Prefer the pages above for product facts. Do not treat client-side app routes under `/project/` as public documentation.
